name: create_flashmla_kv_indices
description: create_flashmla_kv_indices(req_to_token, req_pool_indices, page_kernel_lens, kv_start_idx, kv_indices, page_size) -> kv_indices. For each request i, let n = page_kernel_lens[i], start = kv_start_idx[i] when provided else 0, and num_pages = ceil(n / page_size). Gather req_to_token[pool, start + p*page_size] for p < num_pages and store each gathered slot divided by page_size into kv_indices[i, :num_pages]. The supplied two-dimensional int32 kv_indices is mutated in place and returned; columns beyond num_pages retain their prior contents. kv_start_idx may be None. req_to_token's row stride is honored and wide address arithmetic is selected when the maximum address exceeds 32-bit indexing.
